manifest.name: @tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin
manifest.description: Bundle that ships the wps365-docs skill (read and write WPS 365 cloud documents, Office files, and dbsheet multi-dimensional tables) for the DeepSeek Harness

bundle.text:
# @tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin bundle patch.
#
# ONE insert over the profile root: the skill row. `./index.js` is anchored
# beside this patch file, so the row resolves the entry shipped in the same
# package wherever the bundle is installed from.
#
# The row carries no `config`; every field has a usable default. To point the
# skill at a different wps365-cli or interpreter, override the row by id in the
# profile's own cordis.patch.yml:
#
#   - id: skill-wps365-docs
#     name: './index.js'
#     config:
#       cli: /opt/wps365/bin/wps365-cli
#       python: /usr/local/bin/python3
#
# A patch replaces the targeted row's whole `config`, so restate every field the
# row needs.
- insert:
    - id: skill-wps365-docs
      name: './index.js'

readme.text:
给你的 DSH 装上 **WPS 365 云文档**能力。

本仓库同时支持 DSH 插件和 Codex 本地插件适配，二者版本同步；安装方式分别说明。Codex 版本的源码与构建说明见 [`codex/`](codex/README.md)。

装好之后不用再手动导出、复制粘贴：你可以直接让 agent 读一篇 WPS 智能文档、把内容写进云文档、改云端表格里的某个单元格，它都能真的去读写你的 WPS 365 文档 —— 包括别人通过分享链接给你的文档。

> ⚠️ **本插件仅适用于 WPS 365 企业版账号，个人版账号请勿使用。**
>
> 它调用的是 WPS 365 企业版提供的云文档接口，`wps365-cli` 也必须用企业版账号完成授权。WPS 个人版账号没有这些能力，装上也读写不了任何文档；个人版用户请不要安装，也不要尝试用它处理本地文件。

> 插件本体只提供技能（`wps365-docs`）与配套脚本，**不含**任何 WPS 账号信息；所有云文档操作都由你自己安装的 `wps365-cli` 完成。

---

| 你可以这样说 | 它会做什么 |
|---|---|
| "把这篇 WPS 文档总结一下" / "这篇智能文档里有哪些待办" | 读智能文档（`.otl`）：还原成 Markdown（标题、列表、**表格**、引用、加粗、代码块），长文自动分页读，不把全文塞进上下文 |
| "文档里的那张架构图给我看看" | 下载文档里**所有**内嵌图片到本地（含表格单元格里的图、processon 图），只按需把你要看的那几张读进上下文 |
| "把这份 Markdown 写进这篇智能文档" | 写入智能文档：整篇替换 / 追加到末尾 / 插到最前；写入前可先预演块结构 |
| "把文档里第二段改掉" | 逐段原地编辑智能文档（块级 API），不用整篇重写 |
| "读一下这个 .docx / .xlsx / .pptx" | 下载原件到本地，并抽出正文 Markdown、表格、**公式原文**、每个工作表一份 CSV |
| "把附件里的这个表格改一下再传回去" | 本地编辑后整文件传回：`file_id` 与分享链接不变，版本历史保留、可回滚；也能新建文件 |
| "把云端表格里 B2 改成 99，D2 加上公式" | 云端 `.xlsx` 一条龙：下载 → 改 → 重算公式缓存值 → 传回，一条命令完成 |
| "把这个多维表里的周报列出来" / "按项目筛一下" | 读多维表（`.dbt`）：先看 schema，再分页/过滤读记录；支持视图、字段选择、附件清单，Form 视图会提示改读底层表 |
| "把这条记录的备注改掉" | 快照 → 部分更新 → 读回校验；Link/选项非法值会被接口静默清空，脚本会先校验、写后比对并明确报错 |
| "把周报里那张图下载下来" | 从 raw 记录取 `uploadId` 下载附件；按文件头纠正扩展名（实测服务器会把 PNG 转成 JPEG） |
| "这是别人分享给我的链接，帮我读一下" | 从 kdocs / plus 分享链接解析出文档并正常读取（无需"接收文件"这类前置动作） |
| "帮我把这份文档改一下" | **写入前先比对云端是否已被他人修改**；发现冲突就停下、告诉你冲突在哪，绝不静默覆盖 |
它内置了这套流程里踩过的坑（17 条智能文档硬约束、15 条多维表硬约束、普通文件接口细节、并发写入的实测语义），所以遇到"表格整块消失""公式变成空值""代码块语言被降级""写完下载还是旧内容""多维表写入成功但字段空了"这类问题，它知道该怎么绕。

1. **WPS 365 企业版账号（必须）**
   本插件只适用于 WPS 365 企业版账号；**WPS 个人版账号不受支持，请勿安装和使用**。`wps365-cli` 需要先用企业版账号授权，本文提到的智能文档、云文档读写与分享链接解析能力才会生效。

2. **`wps365-cli`（运行本插件的必要条件；本插件不安装它，只使用它）**
   所有云文档操作都由这个官方 CLI 完成；没装它，插件读写不了任何文档。[`wps365-open/cli`](https://github.com/wps365-open/cli) 是它的源码与文档仓库，用官方安装脚本安装：

**macOS / Linux**

```bash
   curl -fsSL https://open-docs.wpscdn.cn/cli/install.sh | bash
   ```

**Windows（PowerShell）**

```powershell
   irm https://open-docs.wpscdn.cn/cli/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

**Windows（Git Bash）**

```bash
   curl -fsSL https://open-docs.wpscdn.cn/cli/install.sh | bash
   ```

macOS / Linux 默认装到 `~/.local/bin`（无需 sudo），Windows 上是 `~\.local\bin\wps365-cli.exe`。要指定版本或安装目录，在管道末尾的 `bash` 前加环境变量：`... | WPS365_VERSION=v0.3.6 bash`、`... | WPS365_INSTALL_DIR=~/.local/bin bash`；不想用脚本就去 [Release 页面](https://github.com/wps365-open/cli/releases) 下载对应平台的二进制文件。

装好后完成应用绑定与授权（只需一次）：

```bash
   wps365-cli config init        # 新建/绑定应用，在浏览器里完成
   wps365-cli auth login --device
   wps365-cli user me            # 确认当前登录身份
   ```

`config init` 会打开浏览器完成应用创建/绑定与授权确认；企业管理员建议预先设置 CLI 应用免审规则，手动创建应用、配置回调地址与申请权限的完整流程见官方[前置准备：创建应用与权限配置](https://github.com/wps365-open/cli/blob/main/docs/prerequisites.md)。装在别处就在配置里指定 `cli`（见下；支持 `~` 与 `%NAME%`/`${NAME}` 展开，也可以直接写裸命令名让它在 `PATH` 里找）。**CLI 缺失或未授权不会让插件失效**：技能照常可用，只是会在技能正文里明确告诉你 CLI 没找到。

**授权有效期**：access token 只有 2 小时，但 CLI 会在过期前自动刷新、401 透明重试；delegated refresh token 有效 **365 天**且每次刷新轮换。正常情况下 `auth login --device` 一年一次，不必每 2 小时重新登录。refresh token 过期/被撤销、token 存储丢失，或 CLI 回退到 app 身份后报 `required delegated scopes` 时，插件脚本会自动 `auth refresh --delegated`，失败则运行 `auth login --device` 打开浏览器并重试一次；不想自动弹窗可设 `WPS365_NO_AUTO_LOGIN=1`。直接调用 CLI 前也可手动执行 `python3 <技能目录>/scripts/auth.py ensure --cli <cli>`。不要设置 `WPS365_ACCESS_TOKEN`，它会绕过刷新，2 小时后必然失效。官方依据：[用户授权流程](https://open.wps.cn/documents/app-integration-dev/wps365/server/certification-authorization/user-authorization/flow.html)（refresh_token 365 天、刷新时轮换）与 [CLI 认证说明](https://github.com/wps365-open/cli#认证)（自动刷新与 401 重试）。刚登录后 `refresh_token_expires_at` 可能显示 `0001-01-01`（Go 零值/未提供），这不是过期；`auth.py` 会显示为“未知”，不会误触发刷新或重登。

3. **Python（带 openpyxl）**
   读 `.xlsx` 的公式、以及云端改表格需要 openpyxl。默认让 agent 用 `load_workspace_dependencies` 返回的解释器（该环境自带 openpyxl / python-docx）；想固定一个就在配置里指定 `python`。

4. **会话里有 shell 工具**
   脚本由模型通过 shell 执行（macOS / Linux 是 `bash`，Windows 是 PowerShell 或 `cmd`）；另外还需要文件读取工具分页读导出的 `doc.md`、`read_image` 看图片。

5. **平台差异（Windows）**
   技能正文里的命令一律是单行、占位符由插件注入真实值，所以两个平台都能直接照抄；注入的「本机资源」一节会告诉你本机平台、Python 解释器、`wps365-cli` 路径与临时目录。Windows 上另需注意：路径含空格时用双引号包住。

6. **删掉手动安装的同名技能（重要）**
   如果你之前把这份技能手动放在 `~/.dsh/skills/wps365-docs`，同名技能里**它优先级更高**（用户目录里的技能盖住插件自带的），插件的版本就不会被用上。想让插件版本生效：
   ```
   rm -rf ~/.dsh/skills/wps365-docs
   ```
   技能目录是被 watch 的，删完不用重启。

**从 npm 装（推荐）** —— 已发布到 npm，按包名安装即可：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin
```

也可以在 DSH 的插件管理器界面里搜索 `@tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin` 安装。

**从本地目录装**（改插件时用，软链到仓库，改完即时生效；这里的路径是**仓库目录**，与 npm 包名无关）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /绝对路径/dsh-wps365-plugin
```

或让 agent 调用：

```
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "@tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin" }
```

装好后新开一个会话，问一句"读一下这篇 WPS 文档 `<file_id>`"。确认生效的方法：加载进来的技能正文**末尾**会附带一段「本机资源（由 @tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin 注入）」，里面给出脚本目录、`wps365-cli` 路径和该用哪个 Python。

卸载：

```
plugin_manager { action: "remove_bundle", target: "@tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin" }
```

> ⚠️ DSH 插件请使用 **0.1.1 或更高版本**。DSH 的 0.1.0 有一个会让 Harness 打不开的严重问题，它从未发布到 npm；详见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

Codex 版本由 `codex/` 中的源码构建，和上面的 DSH 插件分别安装。Codex 版本同样**仅适用于 WPS 365 企业版账号**，个人版账号请勿使用。克隆仓库后，在仓库根目录构建并运行打包检查：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YiuTerran/dsh-wps365-plugin.git
cd dsh-wps365-plugin
npm --prefix codex run build
npm --prefix codex test

构建需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本；生成 `.tar.gz` 归档还需要系统提供 `tar` 命令。无需运行 `npm install`，构建和检查使用 Node.js 内置模块。构建会生成完整插件目录 `codex/dist/wps365-docs/` 和归档 `codex/dist/wps365-docs-0.2.7.tar.gz`。请把**构建生成的目录**注册并安装；`codex/wps365-docs/` 是源码，不含构建复制进去的共享 Python 脚本，不能直接作为完整插件安装。

在 Codex 中可以这样请求安装：

> 将当前仓库构建得到的 `codex/dist/wps365-docs` 注册到我的个人本地插件市场，并帮我安装。保留已有市场配置。

Codex 的本地插件市场由本机配置发现，市场清单中的插件路径相对于市场根目录。安装到个人本地市场只对当前用户和设备生效，不会发布给其他用户；每位使用者都要安装并授权自己的 `wps365-cli`（安装与授权步骤见上文「需要先准备什么」第 2 条）：

```bash
wps365-cli config init
wps365-cli auth login --device
```

可参考 [Codex 官方插件构建说明](https://developers.openai.com/plugins/build/plugins)。如果安装后插件没有显示，重启 Codex 桌面应用；插件可用后新开一个聊天，再提出文档任务，例如：

> 读取这篇 WPS 文档并概括重点：<分享链接或 file_id>

Codex 使用本地执行环境运行 Python 脚本和 `wps365-cli`。处理 `.xlsx` 需要 `openpyxl`，用 `python-docx` 创建或处理 DOCX 需要 `python-docx`；有 Codex 提供的 `load_workspace_dependencies` 时可使用其中的 Python，否则本机需有相应 Python 依赖。Excel 编辑和公式重算使用当前可用的 Office 技能能力；Codex 版本不依赖 DSH 附带的 LibreOffice Kit。

readme.section: 在其他 Agent 中使用
readme.text:
通用技能位于 [`general-skill/wps365-docs/`](general-skill/wps365-docs/SKILL.md)。将整个 `wps365-docs` 目录复制到目标 Agent 支持的技能目录，再按该 Agent 的方式加载 `SKILL.md`。不支持技能自动发现的 Agent，也可直接读取该文件。请保留随附的 `scripts/` 和 `references/`，不要只复制入口文件。

这个版本不依赖 Codex/DSH 的插件、MCP 工具、运行时注入或提权参数；使用本机 Python 3.10+、自己安装并授权的 `wps365-cli`，以及按任务需要准备的 Office 处理库。仍然仅支持 WPS 365 企业版账号。认证与命令执行权限遵循目标 Agent 自身的审批机制。

readme.section: 在其他 Agent 中使用
readme.text: 该目录可直接使用，无需构建。维护共享 Python 脚本后，运行 `node scripts/sync-general-skill.mjs` 同步通用副本，或加 `--check` 只检查一致性。通用版不携带依赖特定应用运行时探测的 `xlsx_edit.py`；Office 编辑和重算使用目标环境已有能力。现有 npm 包和 Codex 构建的安装方式不变。

插件行的 id 是 `skill-wps365-docs`，三个字段都有默认值，**不配也能用**：

| 字段 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `cli` | `~/.local/bin/wps365-cli` | `wps365-cli` 的位置；设成 `false` 表示不注入 CLI 路径 |
| `python` | 未设置 | 指定跑脚本的解释器（需带 openpyxl / python-docx）；不设则用 `load_workspace_dependencies` 的 |
| `assetRoot` | 插件自带资源目录 | 绝对路径，仅当技能资源被搬到别处时需要 |

在 profile 自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖（patch 是整体替换 `config`，要写全）：

```yaml
- id: skill-wps365-docs
  name: './index.js'
  config:
    cli: /opt/wps365/bin/wps365-cli

字段名写错会在激活时直接报错，不会静默忽略。

> ⚠️ 这个配置是手写的（为了让包保持零依赖），不是 DSH 原生的 schemastery 图，所以 DSH 的配置检查与设置界面**不会**为这一行渲染配置表单（`cordis_inspect_query` 里该行状态显示 `unsupported`）。这不影响插件工作 —— 行照常挂载、技能照常加载、字段校验照常生效，只是改配置要按上面的 YAML 手写。默认值在你的机器上就是对的，通常不用改。

- **云文档没有本地撤销**：插件会按技能要求先导出备份，但重要文档建议你自己也留一份。
- **写入超时不等于写入失败**：智能文档的写入接口、多维表的创建接口都可能已在服务端提交只是响应没回来，所以它重试前会先查块数/记录数，避免写两遍。
- **写入前一定要看冲突结论**：它报冲突时，正确做法是重新拉最新版本、合并你的改动后再写；确实要覆盖才会用强制参数。
- **规模上限**：智能文档单次写入 1000 块（脚本自动分批）；多维表单请求最多 1024 条、限流约 10 次/秒（脚本单批 100）；代码块语言只有接口枚举内的才保留（写 `powershell` 会被静默降级成纯文本，它知道这件事）。
- **普通文件走"下载 → 本地改 → 传回"**：`.docx` / `.xlsx` / `.pptx` 没有可用的逐段写接口，公式、格式、合并、多工作表全靠整文件传回保住。云端 `.xlsx` 的接口写入是异步落盘的，写完不要立刻下载校验。
- **多维表是数据库，不是文档/文件夹**：`drive file list` 会返回空、`file-content` 会报"文档内容抽取失败"；只能走 dbsheet schema/records。FlexPaper 工作表读不了正文/记录，Form 视图不承载记录。
- **授权过期会自动恢复**：脚本检测到 token 过期/CLI 回退 app 身份时，会先刷新；刷新 token 也失效时运行 `auth login --device` 打开浏览器，成功后重试原命令。没有比 refresh token 更长的用户授权；`WPS365_AUTH=app` 可无人值守，但不能替代用户态文档权限。
- **权限边界**：它用你本机 `wps365-cli` 的身份和权限操作云文档，能读写的就是那个账号能读写的东西；插件自己不保存、也不接触凭据。
- **账号边界**：只支持 WPS 365 企业版账号；WPS 个人版账号请勿使用，接口不可用，插件无法工作。
- **上下文开销**：技能正文保持精简，细节（17 条智能文档 + 15 条多维表硬约束、接口细节、并发实测语义）放在四份按需读取的参考文档里，只有真需要时才读。
- **升级**：换版本需要重启 Harness 才会加载新的 JS；只改技能文档（`assets/**`）的话，下次加载技能即生效。
- 本插件**不注册**任何新工具、也不改动你 profile 里的 MCP 配置；`mcp__wps365__*`（如果你配了 WPS 的 MCP）与它是两套独立能力。

离线自查（不需要 Harness、不需要联网、不会碰你的云文档）：

```bash
node --test                        # Node 侧用例：技能解析/资源预算、bundle 与补丁结构、apply() 契约、配置校验、CLI 定位
python3 test/scripts_test.py       # Python 侧契约用例：CLI 定位、管道解码、LibreOffice kit 探测（纯标准库）
python3 test/dbsheet_test.py       # 多维表纯函数与离线下载用例（本地 http.server，不碰云）
node --check index.js

`npm test` 会依次跑这三条；CI 在 Linux 上跑（Windows 语义由注入的假环境覆盖，不依赖真机）。

真实验证：让 agent 读一篇你确定有权限的文档，问它"这篇文档的标题是什么、有几个表格"，确认拿到的是真实内容；再让它用 `--dry-run` 写一次（只做转换、不写入、不产生文件），看块结构与比对输出是否符合预期，然后才动真文档。

readme.section: 仓库结构（想改插件的人看）
readme.text:
```
index.js                      # Host 插件：向 ctx.skills 注册 wps365-docs
src/plugin-config.js          # 配置校验（手写 Standard Schema v1，零依赖）

readme.text: 包已发布到 npm（`publishConfig.access: public`），发布流程与注意事项见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)，版本历史见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。刻意**不声明任何 `dependencies` / `peerDependencies`**：profile 目录解析不到 `@deepseek-ai/*`（它们在 app 包内），而声明 peer 范围会被 DSH 的兼容性检查用来拒绝安装。

- **0.2.9** — 修复智能文档写入与批量同步的 6 项安全问题：覆盖前准备与备份、dry-run 零修改、按目标隔离状态、检查点恢复、图片缓存失效及 prepend 丢写检测；通用 skill 同步修复。本次也包含尚未单独发布的 0.2.8 功能。旧状态文件需保留并改用新的 `--state`。详见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。
- **0.2.8** — 智能文档写入支持本地图片：`otl_write.py` 默认把 Markdown 里的本地图片按出现顺序上传成附件并回填 id 与真实尺寸；新增 `otl_sync.py` 一次把整个 Markdown 目录同步成多个智能文档（含检查点校验后的中断重建）；顺带补上文档标题（新建文档标题块为空，只会显示「输入标题」），并修掉超长表 400、命令行 ARG_MAX、空文档空段落与「返回成功却没落盘」四类坑。详见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。
- **0.2.7** — 按 DSH 的真实沙盒模型改写提权指引：不再使用 Codex 的 `require_escalated`，改为被拒后对同一命令带 `sandbox_permissions` + `justification` 重试；同时修正渲染预算测试并收紧文案，避免 skill 正文被 8192 字符上限截断。共享 Python 脚本未改。详见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。
- **0.2.6** — 受限沙盒中首次认证或云端调用就申请沙盒外执行，后续云端调用保持相同获准权限，避免浏览器授权后才发现无法保存。凭据目录可写探测作为兜底，增加失败阶段标记与 7 项回归。详见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。
- **0.2.5** — 将业务命令的权限错误检测限定于失败退出，避免成功读回的正文包含错误文字时误触发；新增回归并再次通过全量检查。详见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。
- **0.2.4** — 区分凭据存储权限、服务端拒绝 refresh token 与网络/服务端故障。沙盒阻止保存时立即停止并提示申请权限，不重复登录；登录继续实时显示验证提示，新增 15 项认证回归及假 CLI 流程验证。详见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。
- **0.2.3** — 强制直接 CLI 调用前执行 `auth.py ensure`，补全共享链接示例；明确 app 回退后先恢复用户身份再重试、`status` 不刷新、禁用自动登录仍允许 refresh。新增 `ensure --force-refresh` 处理远端拒绝但本地仍有效的 token，并修复 GitHub Release 工

Gives your DSH **WPS 365 cloud document** superpowers.

Once installed there is no more exporting, re-uploading, or copy-paste: ask the agent to read a WPS smart document, write content into one, or change a cell in a cloud spreadsheet, and it will actually operate on your WPS 365 documents — including documents other people shared with you by link.

> ⚠️ **This plugin is only for WPS 365 enterprise accounts. Do not use it with a personal account.**
>
> It calls cloud-document APIs that only WPS 365 enterprise accounts provide, and `wps365-cli` must be authorized with an enterprise account. Personal WPS accounts have no such access, so the plugin cannot read or write any document; please do not install it or try to use it with a personal account.

> The plugin only ships a skill (`wps365-docs`) plus its scripts. It holds **no** WPS account data: every cloud operation runs through the `wps365-cli` you installed.

[中文说明](README.md)

readme.text:
| You can say | It will |
|---|---|
| "Summarize this WPS document" / "What are the action items in this smart document?" | Read a smart document (`.otl`) back into Markdown (headings, lists, **tables**, quotes, bold, code blocks); long documents are read in pages instead of dumping everything into context |
| "Show me the architecture diagram in that document" | Download **all** embedded images (including images inside table cells and processon diagrams) and pull only the ones you ask about into context |
| "Write this Markdown into that smart document" | Write to a smart document: replace the whole body, append, or prepend; preview the block structure first |
| "Change the second paragraph" | Edit a smart document in place, block by block, instead of rewriting the whole thing |
| "Read this .docx / .xlsx / .pptx" | Download the original and extract body Markdown, tables, **original formulas**, and one CSV per worksheet |
| "Fix the spreadsheet in this attachment and put it back" | Edit locally and upload the whole file back: `file_id` and share link stay the same, version history is kept and can be reverted; it can create new files too |

readme.section: What it can do for you
readme.text: It also carries the hard-won lessons of this workflow (17 hard constraints for smart documents, 15 for multi-dimensional tables, the office-file API details, measured concurrency semantics), so problems like "my table disappeared", "formulas turned into empty cells", "the code block language was downgraded", "the download still shows the old content", or "the record write succeeded but the field is empty" are handled instead of stumbled into.

1. **A WPS 365 enterprise account (required)**
   This plugin only works with WPS 365 enterprise accounts; **personal WPS accounts are not supported — do not install or use it with one**. `wps365-cli` must be authorized with an enterprise account before the smart-document, cloud-document, and share-link features described here work.

2. **`wps365-cli` (required to run this plugin; the plugin does not install it, it only uses it)**
   Every cloud operation goes through this official CLI, so without it the plugin cannot read or write any document. [`wps365-open/cli`](https://github.com/wps365-open/cli) is its source and documentation repository; install it with the official installer:

**macOS / Linux**

```bash
   curl -fsSL https://open-docs.wpscdn.cn/cli/install.sh | bash
   ```

**Windows (PowerShell)**

```powershell
   irm https://open-docs.wpscdn.cn/cli/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

**Windows (Git Bash)**

```bash
   curl -fsSL https://open-docs.wpscdn.cn/cli/install.sh | bash
   ```

On macOS / Linux it installs to `~/.local/bin` (no sudo needed); on Windows the binary is `~\.local\bin\wps365-cli.exe`. To pin a version or an install directory, add the environment variable before `bash` at the end of the pipe: `... | WPS365_VERSION=v0.3.6 bash`, `... | WPS365_INSTALL_DIR=~/.local/bin bash`; or download the binary for your platform from the [releases page](https://github.com/wps365-open/cli/releases).

Then bind an app and authorize (once):

```bash
   wps365-cli config init        # create/bind an app in the browser
   wps365-cli auth login --device
   wps365-cli user me            # confirm the signed-in identity
   ```

`config init` opens a browser to create/bind the app and confirm the authorization; enterprise admins should set up the CLI app approval exemption in advance, and the full manual flow for creating an app, registering the callback URL, and requesting permissions is in the official [prerequisites guide](https://github.com/wps365-open/cli/blob/main/docs/prerequisites.md). If it lives elsewhere, set `cli` in the config below (it accepts `~` and `%NAME%` / `${NAME}` expansion, or a bare command name to look up on `PATH`). **A missing or unauthenticated CLI does not break the plugin**: the skill still loads and states plainly that the CLI was not found.

**Token lifetime:** the access token lasts 2 hours, but the CLI refreshes it automatically and retries a 401 transparently. The delegated refresh token lasts **365 days** and rotates on every refresh, so `auth login --device` should be needed about once a year, not every 2 hours. If the refresh token expires or is revoked, the token store is lost, or the CLI falls back to the app identity and reports `required delegated scopes`, the plugin scripts refresh it, then run `auth login --device` (which opens the browser) and retry once. Set `WPS365_NO_AUTO_LOGIN=1` to disable the automatic prompt. You can also run `python3 <skill-dir>/scripts/auth.py ensure --cli <cli>` before direct CLI calls. Do not set `WPS365_ACCESS_TOKEN`: it bypasses storage and refresh and will expire after 2 hours. Sources: the official [user authorization flow](https://open.wps.cn/documents/app-integration-dev/wps365/server/certification-authorization/user-authorization/flow.html) (365-day refresh token, rotated on refresh) and the [CLI authentication notes](https://github.com/wps365-open/cli) (automatic refresh and 401 retry). A fresh login may report `refresh_token_expires_at` as `0001-01-01` (Go's zero time /

3. **Python with openpyxl** — needed to read `.xlsx` formulas and to edit cloud spreadsheets. By default the agent uses the interpreter from `load_workspace_dependencies` (that environment ships openpyxl / python-docx); pin your own with `python`.

4. **A shell tool in the session** — the model runs the scripts through it (`bash` on macOS and Linux, PowerShell or cmd on Windows), plus file reads to page through an exported `doc.md` and `read_image` for pictures.

5. **Windows** — every command in the skill body is a single line and its placeholders are injected by the plugin, so the same instructions run on both platforms. The injected "本机资源" block states your platform, interpreter, `wps365-cli` path and temp directory. On Windows, quote paths that contain spaces.

6. **Remove a hand-installed copy of the same skill (important)**
   If you previously installed this skill by hand at `~/.dsh/skills/wps365-docs`, that copy **wins** over the bundled one (a user-directory skill outranks a bundled skill of the same name), so the plugin's version would never be used. To use the bundled one:
   ```
   rm -rf ~/.dsh/skills/wps365-docs
   ```
   Skill roots are watched, so no restart is needed.

**From npm (recommended)** — install it by package name:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin
```

You can also search for `@tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin` in the DSH Plugin Manager UI.

**From a local directory** (for plugin development — it links the checkout, so edits apply immediately; this path is the **repository directory**, unrelated to the npm name):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/dsh-wps365-plugin
```

Or ask the agent to call:

```
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "@tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin" }
```

Then start a session and ask it to read a WPS document by `file_id`. To confirm it took effect, the loaded skill body ends with a "本机资源（由 @tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin 注入）" block giving the script directory, the `wps365-cli` path, and which Python to use.

Uninstall:

```
plugin_manager { action: "remove_bundle", target: "@tryao/dsh-wps365-plugin" }
```
> ⚠️ Use **0.1.1 or newer**. 0.1.0 has a severe bug that stops Harness from opening; it was never published to npm. See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

The portable skill is in [`general-skill/wps365-docs/`](general-skill/wps365-docs/SKILL.md). Copy the entire `wps365-docs` directory into your agent's supported skill location and load `SKILL.md` using that agent's conventions. Agents without skill discovery can read the entrypoint directly. Keep the accompanying `scripts/` and `references/`; the entrypoint alone is not a complete installation.

This version requires no Codex/DSH plugin, MCP tool, injected runtime, or host-specific permission flag. It uses local Python 3.10+, your own installed and authorized `wps365-cli`, and Office libraries appropriate to the task. A WPS 365 enterprise account is still required. Authentication and command approvals follow the target agent's own policy.

No build is needed. After changing canonical Python helpers, run `node scripts/sync-general-skill.mjs` to update the portable copies, or add `--check` to verify parity without writing. The portable skill omits `xlsx_edit.py`, whose recalculation discovery depends on a particular application runtime; use available local Office tooling instead. Existing npm and Codex installation paths are unchanged.

The row id is `skill-wps365-docs`. All three fields have defaults, so **no config is required**:

| Field | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `cli` | `~/.local/bin/wps365-cli` | where `wps365-cli` lives; `false` stops reporting a CLI path |
| `python` | unset | interpreter for the scripts (needs openpyxl / python-docx); unset defers to `load_workspace_dependencies` |
| `assetRoot` | the bundled assets | absolute path, only needed if the skill assets are relocated |

Override the row in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (a patch replaces the whole `config`, so restate every field):

```yaml
- id: skill-wps365-docs
  name: './index.js'
  config:
    cli: /opt/wps365/bin/wps365-cli

A mistyped field fails activation instead of being ignored.

> ⚠️ This config is hand-written (to keep the package dependency-free) rather than a native Schemastery graph, so DSH's config inspection and settings UI do **not** render a config form for this row (`cordis_inspect_query` reports it as `unsupported`). It does not affect the plugin: the row mounts, the skill loads, and field validation still runs — only *changing* the config means editing the YAML above. The defaults are already right on a normal install.

- **Cloud documents have no local undo**: the skill exports a backup before writing, but keep your own copy of anything important.
- **A write timeout is not a failed write**: the smart-document and record-create APIs may have committed while the response was lost, so it checks the block/record count before retrying rather than writing twice.
- **Read the conflict verdict**: when it reports a conflict, the right move is to pull the latest version and merge; forcing an overwrite takes an explicit flag.
- **Limits**: 1000 blocks per write for smart documents (the script batches automatically); 1024 records per dbsheet request and about 10 requests/second (the script caps a batch at 100); code-block languages outside the API enum are kept as plain text (`powershell` is silently downgraded — it knows).
- **Office files go "download → edit locally → upload back"**: `.docx` / `.xlsx` / `.pptx` have no usable per-paragraph write API; preserving formulas, formatting, merges, and multiple sheets depends on uploading the whole file. Cloud `.xlsx` API writes land asynchronously, so verifying by download immediately after writes is misleading.

Offline self-check (no Harness, no network, no access to your documents):

```bash
node --test                    # skill parsing and asset budgets, bundle/patch structure, apply() contract, config
python3 test/scripts_test.py   # CLI discovery, pipe decoding, LibreOffice kit detection (stdlib only)
python3 test/dbsheet_test.py   # dbsheet pure functions + an offline loopback download; no cloud calls
node --check index.js

Real check: have the agent read a document you know you can access and ask what its title is and how many tables it has, to confirm the content is real; then have it write once with `--dry-run` (converts without writing and creates nothing) to inspect the block structure and comparison output before touching a real document.

readme.text: Asset paths are written as a `{skillDir}` placeholder and resolved into real absolute paths at load time, so the same assets work from a profile bundle, a workspace bundle, or a packaged app.

readme.section: Repository layout (for people changing the plugin)
readme.text: The package is published to npm (`publishConfig.access: public`). The release procedure lives in [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md) and the version history in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). It deliberately declares **no `dependencies` / `peerDependencies`**: a profile directory cannot resolve `@deepseek-ai/*` (those live inside the app bundle), and declaring peer ranges only gives DSH's compatibility check a reason to reject the install.
